commands.review_summary:
Defers the macOS browser-cookie import offer from app launch and Gateway connection to the first inline-browser open, with retry and one-shot state handling, regression tests, documentation, and localization inventory updates.

PR surface: Docs 0, Other +136. Total +136 across 7 files.

Reproducibility: yes. from source and exact-head discussion: open the inline browser before onboarding completes, then finish onboarding while it remains open; no dashboard update invokes the armed retry. A real app run was not supplied, so this is source-reproducible rather than directly reproduced here.

target.title: fix(macos): defer cookie import banner until inline browser opens
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes the macOS cookie-import banner appearing while the embedded dashboard is still showing its Gateway connection or authentication screen. The automatic offer previously ran after app launch and every Gateway connection, before the inline browser was used.

## Why This Change Was Made

The automatic offer is now armed only when the inline browser first opens. Pre-onboarding, remote-Gateway, failed startup, and overlapping reconnect attempts remain armed until one host-local status query completes. That completed query consumes the one-shot; later inline-browser opens stay silent. Settings -> General -> Browser login -> Import remains the explicit re-offer path.

This is the narrow timing follow-up to the inline banner introduced in #104591. AI-assisted; reviewed with the repository autoreview helper.

## User Impact

The Gateway connection/authentication screen stays clear. Eligible local-Gateway users see the cookie-import offer only when inline browsing becomes relevant.

## Evidence

- Added macOS regressions for silent dashboard launch, first inline-browser arming, failed status retry, overlapping reconnect-event retry, first completed-query consumption, and later-open suppression.
- `swift test --package-path apps/macos --filter 'BrowserProfileImportModelTests|DashboardWindowSmokeTests'` - 45 tests passed.
- SwiftFormat lint - no files require formatting.
- SwiftLint strict - 0 violations.
- Native i18n sync/check - 4,320 entries; final check reports no drift.
- Repository autoreview fix cycle - clean, no accepted/actionable findings.
- Exact-head Blacksmith Testbox changed gate (`tbx_01kxdtp5fc1dfdswdpmgnhn96h`) - all routed Vitest shards and repository gates passed: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29253960241
- Exact-head release gate - completed successfully: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29255945462
- Hosted macOS Swift lane - lint, release build, and full Swift tests passed: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29255945462/job/86840262584

A signed Developer ID build completed and passed code-signature verification. Interactive visual capture was blocked by macOS secure Screen Recording and Keychain approval prompts; no security setting or credential was changed.
